results.name: sub_one_dvd_pow_sub_one
results.source_text:
lemma sub_one_dvd_pow_sub_one (x : R) (n : ℕ) : x - 1 ∣ x ^ n - 1 := by
  conv_rhs => rw [← one_pow n]
  exact (Commute.one_right x).sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow n

results.source_text:
lemma rpow_sub_one' (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h : y - 1 ≠ 0) : x ^ (y - 1) = x ^ y / x := by
  rw [rpow_sub' hx h, rpow_one]

lemma one_sub_dvd_one_sub_pow (x : R) (n : ℕ) : 1 - x ∣ 1 - x ^ n := by
  conv_rhs => rw [← one_pow n]
  exact (Commute.one_left x).sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow n

results.name: PowerSeries.invOneSubPow
results.source_text:
/--
Given a natural number `d : ℕ` and a commutative ring `S`, `PowerSeries.invOneSubPow S d` is the
multiplicative inverse of `(1 - X) ^ d` in `S⟦X⟧ˣ`. When `d` is `0`, `PowerSeries.invOneSubPow S d`
will just be `1`. When `d` is positive, `PowerSeries.invOneSubPow S d` will be the power series
`mk fun n => Nat.choose (d - 1 + n) (d - 1)`.
-/
noncomputable def invOneSubPow : ℕ → S⟦X⟧ˣ
  | 0 => 1
  | d + 1 => {
    val := mk fun n => Nat.choose (d + n) d
    inv := (1 - X) ^ (d + 1)
    val_inv := by
      rw [← mk_one_pow_eq_mk_choose_add, ← mul_pow, mk_one_mul_one_sub_eq_one, one_pow]
    inv_val := by
      rw [← mk_one_pow_eq_mk_choose_add, ← mul_pow, mul_comm, mk_one_mul_one_sub_eq_one, one_pow]
    }
results.docstring:
Given a natural number `d : ℕ` and a commutative ring `S`, `PowerSeries.invOneSubPow S d` is the
multiplicative inverse of `(1 - X) ^ d` in `S⟦X⟧ˣ`. When `d` is `0`, `PowerSeries.invOneSubPow S d`
will just be `1`. When `d` is positive, `PowerSeries.invOneSubPow S d` will be the power series
`mk fun n => Nat.choose (d - 1 + n) (d - 1)`.

/-- The submonoid generated by an element. -/
def powers (n : M) : Submonoid M :=
  Submonoid.copy (mrange (powersHom M n)) (Set.range (n ^ · : ℕ → M)) <|
    Set.ext fun n => exists_congr fun i => by simp; rfl
results.docstring: The submonoid generated by an element.

results.name: QuantumMechanics.radiusPowLM_apply_polyBddSchwartz_memHS
results.source_text:
lemma radiusPowLM_apply_polyBddSchwartz_memHS {d : ℕ} {s : ℝ}
    (ψ : PolyBddSchwartzSubmodule d ⌊1 - d / 2 - s⌋.toNat) :
    MemHS (𝐫[d] s (polyBddSchwartzEquiv.symm ψ)) :=
  let f := polyBddSchwartzEquiv.symm ψ
  radiusPowLM_apply_memHS s f.1 ⌊1 - d / 2 - s⌋.toNat f.2 (add_floor_toNat_pos_aux d s)
